name: tokenpilot
description: Builds a smaller chat turn from the code graph, routes it by task and budget, and shows the input token count.

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/extension.js --external:vscode --external:typescript --format=cjs --platform=node --sourcemap && esbuild src/hookEntry.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/turn-hook.js --format=cjs --platform=node && esbuild src/reduceCli.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/reduce.js --format=cjs --platform=node
scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && esbuild test/optimize.test.ts test/graph.test.ts test/bifrost.test.ts test/hook.test.ts test/harness.test.ts test/reduce.test.ts --bundle --outdir=dist-test --outbase=test --platform=node --format=cjs --external:typescript && node --test dist-test/optimize.test.js dist-test/graph.test.js dist-test/bifrost.test.js dist-test/hook.test.js dist-test/harness.test.js dist-test/reduce.test.js

tokenpilot.bifrostUrl.description: Bifrost gateway origin, without a path.

tokenpilot.bifrostPath.description: Chat completions path. Use /openai/v1/chat/completions if the gateway only exposes the OpenAI prefix.

tokenpilot.localUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible origin for the local model. Ollama listens on port 11434.

tokenpilot.localModel.description: Model id sent to the local server. Confidential repositories use only this model.

tokenpilot.strongModel.description: Bifrost provider/model for edits and design tasks.

tokenpilot.budgetUsd.description: Spending limit for the current user, in USD.

tokenpilot.userId.description: User id for the spending ledger. Empty uses the OS user name.

tokenpilot.confidential.description: Treat the open workspace as a confidential repository.
